brief:
Palestinian women in Jalameh, a village north of Jenin, have revived organic loofah farming as a commercial export venture, according to Palestine News Network. The agricultural initiative transforms a dormant farming tradition into an eco-friendly business serving global markets.

The project operates in the agricultural fields of the West Bank community, where participants are developing what they describe as a sustainable production model tied to environmental conservation and rural economic development.
dek: JENIN/ West Bank In the agricultural fields of Jalameh, a small village north of Jenin, a group of Palestinian women are transforming a forgotten agricultural tradition into a flourishing, eco-friendly export industry.
title: Palestinian women revive organic loofah farming for export markets
